description: Most December candidates derive solely from CILIP's secondary chronology; no individual local contemporary article was assessed/opened for Dec 2, 6, 12, 20 or 31.

description: State-targeted demands are unclear for the Düsseldorf counterprotest, Dresden counterprotest, Dec 30 prison gathering and solidarity/counter-Querdenken groups; do not infer a policy demand from an opposing target or location.

description: Police report describes up to 80 at one Berlin gathering with some later joining a separate approximately 350-person march; event overlap may produce double counting.

description: The Dec 30 'Silvester zum Knast' assembly was shifted from a planned Dec 31 event. Broader anti-COVID protests recur across dates, but continuous event onset/closure and January continuity have not been established.
required_followup: Check adjacent November and January reporting; keep this event assigned to Dec 30 as its reported actual start.

description: Search coverage emphasizes COVID-related demonstrations in Berlin and cities listed by CILIP. Other sectors, regions, languages and week-specific local reporting remain undercovered; absence in search results is not evidence of absence.
required_followup: Broaden German-language regional searches for labor, housing, climate, education, migration, agriculture and local-policy action.
